cases.text:
Great news — yes, you can use a Trailforge gift card to pay for your order! According to **kb/15-gift-cards.md**, gift cards can be used **online or in-store**, so they're a valid payment option at checkout.

For reference, the accepted payment methods listed in **kb/08-payment-billing-faq.md** cover cards and digital wallets, but your gift card is confirmed as usable for purchases per the gift card policy.

If you run into any trouble applying your gift card at checkout, feel free to reach out to our support team:
- **Chat:** Available on the website during business hours
- **Email:** support@trailforge.example
- **Phone:** 1-800-555-0199
